correctness.rationale: Every shortest path between cliques crosses the unique Exp(beta) bridge. Memorylessness and exchangeability give independent clique discovery holding times Exp(k(n-k)/n) and nongate gate rank J uniform on {2,...,n}; exact T=max(F_n,H_n+E_beta+F_n_prime) where H_n is partial sum up to J-1 (dependent on F_n). For nongate, H_n-log n tends to Gumbel plus logit(U); second clique F_n_prime-2log n tends to independent two-Gumbel sum; first clique F_n is lower by log n and exponential-moment control makes its positive correction vanish in L2. Therefore T-3log n converges to three Gumbels + logistic + Exp(beta) with mgf beta/(beta-s)*Gamma(1-s)^4*Gamma(1+s) and mean/variance constants 3gamma+1/beta,5pi^2/6+1/beta^2. At gate H_n=0; the exact maximum yields T-2log n -> max(two independent Gumbel sums, exponential bridge plus independent two-Gumbel sum). Independently computed exact rational CTMC infected-count expectations for n=2..5 at rates beta=1/2,1,3, obtaining e.g. n=2,beta=1 nongate=5,gate=11/3; independent Gumbel/logistic MGF factor at s=1/4 evaluated. No finite test stands for limiting proof.
